skills.name: Basic
skills.desc: Deals 120% ATK DMG to a single target.

skills.name: Ultimate
skills.desc: Atomic Samurai launches 30 slashes, each Crit Hit reducing all enemies' [Total DMG Reduction] by 1%. He then unleashes a powerful slash dealing 5000% ATK Specialized Direct DMG to all enemies (affected only by advanced DMG reduction), ignoring 55% [Specialized Evasion] and [Non-Crit DMG Reduction], and penetrating [Unyielding] and [Specialized Unyielding]. On the first cast, additionally reduces all enemies' [Specialized HP] by 100%.

skills.name: Ultra-Ultimate
skills.desc: Slashes 30 > 50 times. ATK 5000% > 7000%. Ignore Specialized Evasion and [Non-Crit DMG Reduction] 55% > 80%. Reduce [Specialized HP] of all enemies 100% > 175%.

skills.name: Passive
skills.desc: Gains 60% [Non-Crit DMG Reduction] at the start of battle. Removes all enemy [Suppression DMG Increase] and [Suppression DMG Reduction] debuffs. When dealing Specialized Direct DMG, ignores 40% of the enemy's [Critical Resistance].

skills.name: Awaken 1 Passive
skills.desc: At the start of battle, grants Atomic Samurai 20% SPD boost to Specialization. When taking damage, there is a chance to reduce that damage by 40% (the chance is twice the user's current Crit Hit rate). If the user is among the first two allies to act, they gain 30% Crit Hit rate and 50% Crit Hit DMG.

skills.name: Awaken 2 Passive
skills.desc: Speed boost 20% > 30% Reduce dmg by 40% > 70% Crit hit rate 30% > 50% Crit hit dmg 50% > 80%

effects.desc: Reduces the amount of damage taken thanks to the Suppression effect.
Reduced damage taken from non-critical attacks.
The PvP tier's unique health bar stacks on top of regular health, must also be depleted, and can be restored independently.
Advanced tier of direct damage, only affected by advanced damage increase/decrease and passes through normal defenses.
Attack buff gives 30-40% mana and increases damage, increasing by 150-170% when the bearer's Attack is higher than the target.
